title: Protocol to isolate immune cells from mouse pancreatic lymph nodes and whole pancreas for mass cytometric analyses
protocol: Euthanize mouse and open abdominal cavity.
Identify the pancreas in the abdominal cavity.
Harvest the pancreas carefully into a culture dish containing HBSS buffer.
Transfer the pancreas into a 15 mL tube.
Add 3 mL collagenase P digestion media to the tube.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 min on an orbital shaker at 240 rpm.
Prepare a single cell suspension by drawing up digested tissue into a 5 or 10 mL syringe and gently passing through an 18G needle into a new 15 mL tube.
Top off with 5 mL HBSS containing 10% FBS to inactivate collagenase P.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 450 × g for 5 min at room temperature (15°C–25°C) and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cell pellet in 3 mL PBS + 2% FBS, and filter suspended cells through a 70 μm cell strainer.
Pipette 3 mL Histopaque 1077 into a new 15 mL conical tube.
Slowly and gently layer the suspended cells from the cell strainer on top of Histopaque 1077.
Centrifuge tube at 900 × g for 20 min at room temperature in a swinging bucket rotor with the centrifuge brake turned off.
Remove the pancreatic lymph nodes and place them in a 35 mm culture dish containing 2 mL cold RPMI media (no FBS).
Press the lymph nodes through a 100 μm cell strainer into a 50 mL conical tube using the plunger from a syringe.
Rinse the cell strainer with 5 mL RPMI media (no FBS).
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 450 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL red blood cell lysis buffer.
Incubate for 1 min at room temperature.
Add 10 mL PBS containing 2% FBS.
Centrifuge at 450 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 5 mL Immune cell culture media.
Wash the collected cells by adding 3 mL RPMI containing 10% FBS.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 450 × g for 5 min at room temperature.
Discard the supernatant and repeat washing step.
Resuspend the cells in 500 μL Immune cell culture media.
Transfer 10 μL of cell suspension into a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Combine with 90 μL trypan blue, mixing well with a pipette.
Load 10 μL of this mixture into a hemocytometer.
Count the cells and calculate the total number of cells per sample.
Transfer an appropriate number of cells (1 × 10^6–3 × 10^6) into each well of a 96 well U-bottom plate.
Add 100 μL PMA, Ionomycin, and Golgi Stop media to the wells.
Incubate the plate for 4 h at 37°C under 5% CO2.
Scrape the immune cells and transfer to a FACS tube.
Add 2 mL PBS into each tube and centrifuge at 450 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and add 300 μL of the 5 μM Cisplatin Solution to each tube.
Pipette to mix and incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Add 2 mL Maxpar Cell Staining Buffer to each tube.
Centrifuge the cells at 300 × g for 5 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant and flick the tube to disrupt the pellet.
Repeat steps of adding buffer, centrifuging, aspirating supernatant, and disrupting the pellet.
Discard the supernatant leaving behind 50 μL Maxpar Cell Staining buffer in each tube.
Pipette to mix and incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Add 50 μL of diluted Surface marker antibody cocktail to each tube.
Pipette to mix.
Incubate for 30 min at room temperature.
Add 2 mL Maxpar Cell Staining buffer.
Centrifuge the cells at 300 × g for 5 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Gently vortex to resuspend cells in residual volume.
Fix the cells by adding 1 mL Maxpar Fix I buffer.
Gently vortex and incubate for 10–30 min at room temperature.
Wash the cells by adding 2 mL Maxpar Perm-S buffer.
Centrifuge at 800 × g for 5 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Repeat step of washing cells with Maxpar Perm-S buffer.
Add 50 μL of cytoplasmic/secreted antibody cocktail to each tube for a final volume of 100 μL.
Gently vortex and incubate for 30 min at room temperature.
Wash cells by adding 2 mL Maxpar Cell Staining Buffer.
Centrifuge at 800 × g for 5 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Add 300 μL Maxpar Fix/Perm with DNA intercalator.
Vortex to mix and incubate at 4°C overnight (16–20 h).
Centrifuge the cells at 800 × g for 5 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Gently vortex to resuspend cells in residual volume.
Add 2 mL Maxpar Cell Staining buffer and centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant and gently vortex to resuspend cells in residual volume.
Repeat steps of adding 2 mL Maxpar Cell Staining buffer, centrifuging at 300 × g for 5 min, aspirating the supernatant, and vortexing two more times.
Wash the cells with 2 mL Maxpar Water and centrifuge at 800 × g for 5 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant and gently vortex to resuspend cells in residual volume.
Resuspend the cells with 1 mL Maxpar Water.
Count the cells using a hemocytometer.
Dilute 5 × 10^5 cells into 1 mL Maxpar Water and centrifuge the cells at 800 × g for 5 min at room temperature.
Discard supernatant and keep cell pellet on ice until running on a mass cytometer.
Resuspend 5 × 10^5 (maximum 1 × 10^6) cells in 1 mL Maxpar Water containing 0.1× EQ4 beads within 10 min of running the sample.
Filter cells through a 35 μm cell strainer cap into a 5 mL polypropylene tube.
Place sample into the Sample Loader.
Click record to start acquisition.
